messages:
Priya: quick heads-up — ran the nightly link-scan after the nav refactor and found ~7 dead links under /runbooks/model-handling. Not breaking prod but will confuse new hires. Can someone own triage?

docs-bot: LinkScan summary: 7 dead links (anchors + shortlinks). Report: https://internal/reports/linkscan/1766543211 — flagged severity: medium.

Priya: pinging @Jon and @Marcos since you both edited that runbook last week.

Jon: I can take this on tonight, will do a quick audit of anchors and shortlink redirects. Any preferred redirect behavior? 301 vs 302?

Priya: prefer 301/shortlink -> canonical KB shortlink where content still exists. If content removed, add 410 + migration note. Keep it simple for the onboarding flow.

Marcos: FYI I opened a tiny PR yesterday that renamed a few header anchors — that likely broke the fragment links. PR: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/458. Should be a quick fix.

Eve: if Jon posts the PR number I can queue the docs-linter and staging preview. Also will run the link-checker once deployed.

Jon: opening PR now, will include a sed patch for the obvious path rename and a frontmatter sweep. Patch snippet in PR description: `sed -i 's#/runbooks/model-handling/#/runbooks/model-handling-v2/#g' content/runbooks/**/*.md`

Marcos: also check frontmatter `canonical_url` values — I found two that still point to the old route. If those are stale we should update them instead of redirecting.

Marisa: tiny nit — put the user-visible behavior in the PR: whether links will 301 -> new slugs or 410 + migration note. That helps support triage if we see user reports.

Priya: deadline ask: can we get this PR up before end-of-day PST so staging preview can validate for tomorrow's onboarding smoke-test? If not, flag it and we can gate the onboarding checklist.

Jon: yes — will aim to have PR up in the next 2 hours. Tagging @Eve for preview once it's open.

docs-bot: deploy-preview queued: staging-456 for PR #462 (queued by Jon). Link: https://staging.previews/internal/456

Priya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Jon — once PR is merged, please add yourself or Marcos to CODEOWNERS for `/content/runbooks/` so followups are clearer.

Jon: done — added Marcos to CODEOWNERS and included a short changelog entry in the PR.

Eve: linter & link-check passed on staging preview, no more dead anchors reported.

Priya: awesome. I'll close the onboarding-blocker task in Asana and leave a note for the next cohort.

Marcos: glhf, thanks for the quick turnaround!
